items.title: 67426_Hayes Pillars oral history interview
items.q: On the piano, we had Serp Goodson.

ctx.x: : Who -- was in the band at that time, what was the personnel?

The personnel of the band, at that time, was our reed section, Charles Pillars, Hayes Pillars and James Jeter. In the brass section, he -- we had Harry Sweets Edison, and Leo Snub Mosley on the trombone. On the piano, we had Serp Goodson. On the bass -- on the drums we had A. G. Godley, and on the bass we had Nunu -- on the bass. His name was Louie Pitts --
